Organiser, I want to log in with my registered credentials so that I can access my organisation's event information securely."}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "### Acceptance criteria"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "#### Scenario 1 — Valid credentials accepted"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Given I am a registered user with valid credentials When I submit my email address and password Then I am signed in and taken to the dashboard for my role"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "#### Scenario 2 — Wrong password reveals nothing"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Given I am a registered user When I submit an incorrect password Then I remain signed out and see a message that does not reveal whether the email address is registered"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "#### Scenario 3 — Lockout on fifth failure"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Given I have submitted 5 consecutive incorrect passwords When I attempt to sign in again Then my account is locked and I am shown how to reset my password"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "#### Scenario 4 — Reset link issued"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": Lock lifted on new password"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Given I have followed a valid reset link When I set a new password Then the lock is lifted and I can sign - **Owner**: Aaron"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "### User story"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "As an Event Organiser, I want to save an incomplete event request as a draft so that I can gather the missing information and complete it later."}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "### Acceptance criteria"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "#### Scenario 1 — Draft saved and hidden from Coordinators"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Given I have partially completed a request When I save it as a draft Then it is stored with status Draft and is not visible to Event Coordinators"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "#### Scenario 2 — Draft reopened with values restored"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Given I have a saved draft When I reopen it Then all previously entered values are restored"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "#### Scenario 3 — Draft deleted"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Given I have a draft I no longer need When I delete it Then it is removed from my list and is not counted as an active request"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "#### Scenario 4 — Completed draft submitted"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Given a draft has every mandatory field complete When I submit it Then it follows E02-S01 and its status becomes Submitted"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "### Checklist"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "- Save an event request without completing all mandatory fields

- Continue editing a saved draft
- Delete a draft I no longer need
- Confirm that Event Coordinators cannot see my drafts"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Decisions: https://github.com/hongyime/sgConnectSphere2026/tree/main/docs/bdr and https://github.com/hongyime/sgConnectSphere2026/tree/main/docs/adr

- **Points**: 3
- **BDR references**: C-12, C-41, C-55, C-56, T-14, T-15
- **Owner**:"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "### User story"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "As an Event Organiser, I want my submitted request to be assigned an Event Coordinator automatically so that my event has one clear internal owner from the outset."}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "### Acceptance criteria"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "#### Scenario 1 — Exactly one Coordinator assigned"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Given a request is submitted When submission completes Then the system assigns exactly one Event Coordinator, the status becomes Under Review, and that Coordinator is notified"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "#### Scenario 2 — Fewest active events wins"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Given several Event Coordinators are available When the system assigns one Then it selects the Coordinator with the fewest active events"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "#### Scenario 3 — Reassignment requested"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Given I am the assigned Coordinator and a reassignment has been agreed offline When I request reassignment to a named colleague Then the request is recorded, that colleague is notified, and I remain assigned until they accept"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "#### Scenario 4 — Reassignment accepted"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Given a reassignment request is awaiting my acceptance When I accept it Then I become the assigned Coordinator, the previous assignment ends, and the change is recorded in the activity log"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "#### Scenario 5 — Reassignment declined"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Given a reassignment request is awaiting acceptance When the named colleague declines it Then the original Coordinator remains assigned and is notified of the refusal"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "#### Scenario 6 — Unassigned Coordinator refused"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Given I am not the assigned Coordinator When I attempt to reassign the event Then the action is refused"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "### Checklist"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "- Confirm that exactly one Event Coordinator is assigned on submission
- Confirm the assigned Coordinator is the one with the fewest active events
- Confirm the status moves from Submitted to Under Review
- Request reassignment to a named colleague as the assigned Coordinator
- Confirm the original Coordinator stays assigned until the colleague accepts
- Accept a reassignment request and take ownership of the event
- Decline a reassignment request, leaving the original Coordinator assigned
- Be refused when attempting to reassign an event assigned to someone else"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Decisions: https://github.com/hongyime/sgConnectSphere2026/tree/main/docs/bdr and https://github.com/hongyime/sgConnectSphere2026/tree/main/docs/adr
Acceptance cases: https://github.com/hongyime/sgConnectSphere2026/blob/main/docs/testing/cases/E03.md
Automation inventory: https://github.com/hongyime/sgConnectSphere2026/blob/main/docs/testing/tc-coverage.md"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Sprint 1 GitHub reconciliation — 20 September 2026

- **Points**: 3
- **BDR references**: C-08, T-39
- **Owner**:"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "### User story"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "As a Venue Staff member, I want to approve or reject booking requests and record my reasoning so that Coordinators receive a clear, traceable decision."}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "### Acceptance criteria"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "#### Scenario 1 — Request approved and confirmed"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Given a booking request is pending and the venue is free for the period When I approve it Then the booking becomes Confirmed, the venue calendar is updated and the Coordinator is notified"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "#### Scenario 2 — Rejected with reason and alternative"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Given I reject a request When I record a reason and optionally suggest an alternative venue Then the Coordinator is notified with both, and can amend the request to the suggested alternative without restarting the search"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "#### Scenario 3 — Rejection without reason blocked"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Given I attempt to reject without recording a reason When I confirm Then the rejection is blocked"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "### Checklist"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "- Approve a pending booking request for a free venue
- Confirm the booking becomes Confirmed and the calendar updates
- Reject a request with a recorded reason
- Be blocked from rejecting without a reason
- Suggest an alternative venue alongside a rejection
- Confirm the Coordinator can amend the request to the suggested venue without starting a new search
- Confirm the Coordinator is notified of either decision"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Decisions: https://github.com/hongyime/sgConnectSphere2026/tree/main/docs/bdr and https://github.com/hongyime/sgConnectSphere2026/tree/main/docs/adr

Scenarios tagged \"(assumes O-xx)\" are written to the default recorded in "}, {"type": "text", "text": "docs/bdr/C-open-questions.md", "marks": [{"type": "code"}]}, {"type": "text", "text": "."}]}, {"type": "heading", "attrs": {"level": 3}, "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Acceptance criteria"}]}, {"type": "heading", "attrs": {"level": 4}, "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Scenario 1 — Unavailability recorded with a reason"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Given I am viewing a venue When I mark it unavailable for a period and choose a reason category from maintenance, equipment failure, renovation, safety concern or other, with a free-text note Then the unavailability is saved with the period, the category, the note and my identity, and the calendar shows the period as Blocked"}]}, {"type": "heading", "attrs": {"level": 4}, "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Scenario 2 — Overlapping bookings become Conflicting, not released"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Given the venue has a Pending request and a Confirmed booking inside the period When I save the unavailability Then the save succeeds, both bookings are marked Conflicting, neither is released or cancelled, and the two affected events are listed to me on save"}]}, {"type": "heading", "attrs": {"level": 4}, "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Scenario 3 — The event itself is untouched"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Given a Confirmed event's booking has just become Conflicting When anyone views that event Then its status is still Confirmed, every other arrangement is intact, and a venue-conflict flag with the reason category is shown; the event changes status only when its Coordinator acts (assumes O-24)"}]}, {"type": "heading", "attrs": {"level": 4}, "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Scenario 4 — Affected Coordinators informed"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Given the unavailability made one or more bookings Conflicting When it is saved Then the Coordinator of each affected event receives an in-app and email notification naming the venue, the period, the reason category and the event, and stating that alternative arrangements are required (assumes O-25)"}]}, {"type": "heading", "attrs": {"level": 4}, "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Scenario 5 — End date required and extendable"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Given I am recording an unavailability When I omit the end date and time Then the save is refused; and Given a saved unavailability When I extend its end Then bookings newly inside the longer period are handled as in Scenario 2 (assumes O-23)"}]}, {"type": "heading", "attrs": {"level": 4}, "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Scenario 6 — Unavailability shortened or ended early"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Given a booking is Conflicting only because of an unavailability When I shorten or end that unavailability so the booking no longer overlaps it Then the Conflicting flag clears and the booking stands as it was; a booking the Coordinator has already cancelled or replaced is not restored (assumes O-26)"}]}, {"type": "heading", "attrs": {"level": 3}, "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Checklist"}]}, {"type": "bulletList", "content": [{"type": "listItem", "content": [{"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Mark a venue unavailable for a period with a reason category and a note, including when Pending or Confirmed bookings fall inside the period"}]}]}, {"type": "listItem", "content": [{"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "See the affected events listed on save and their bookings marked Conflicting, with none released or cancelled"}]}]}, {"type": "listItem", "content": [{"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Confirm the affected events keep their status and other arrangements, with a visible venue-conflict flag"}]}]}, {"type": "listItem", "content": [{"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Confirm each affected Coordinator is notified in-app and by email"}]}]}, {"type": "listItem", "content": [{"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Be refused an unavailability with no end date and time"}]}]}, {"type": "listItem", "content": [{"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Confirm shortening or ending an unavailability clears the Conflicting flag on bookings it no longer touches"}]}]}, {"type": "listItem", "content": [{"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Confirm E05-S04's existing block, shorten and remove behaviour still works for periods with no bookings"}]}]}]}]}

- **Points**: (unestimated)
- **BDR references**: C-07, C-20
- **Owner**: (unassigned)"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Follow-up to completed E07-S01 (#214), raised during E07-S05 integration review (#249). Keep SCRUM-51 Done."}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "### User story"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "As a Technical Support Staff member, I want catalogue stock reductions to account for dated equipment withdrawals so that reservations which no longer fit are flagged and their Coordinators are notified."}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "### Acceptance criteria"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "#### Scenario 1 - Reduced usable stock flags reservations"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Given an item has total stock 10, four units withdrawn and five units reserved for the same future period When I reduce total stock to 8 Then the save succeeds, the reservation remains reserved but is marked for review, and its assigned active Coordinator receives one notification and an outbox record"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "#### Scenario 2 - Only simultaneous remaining demand counts"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Given reservations and dated withdrawals have different or adjacent periods When I reduce total stock Then only simultaneous demand in each reservation's remaining period is compared against the new stock; a withdrawal starting midway through the reservation is included, non-overlapping withdrawal quantities are not summed, and exact fits are not flagged"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "#### Scenario 3 - Notification failure rolls back the edit"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Given a stock reduction would flag a reservation because of a withdrawal When notification persistence fails Then the stock change, new review flag and notification all roll back"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "### Checklist"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "- Include dated withdrawals and their start boundaries in catalogue capacity checks
- Preserve half-open adjacency and ignore ended demand
- Keep reservations intact while flagging shortages
- Notify each affected assigned active Coordinator once per stock edit
- Roll back stock, flags and notification/outbox writes together on failure"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Decisions: https://github.com/hongyime/sgConnectSphere2026/tree/main/docs/bdr and https://github.com/hongyime/sgConnectSphere2026/tree/main/docs/adr"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Acceptance cases: https://github.com/hongyime/sgConnectSphere2026/blob/main/docs/testing/cases/E07.md"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Automation inventory: https://github.com/hongyime/sgConnectSphere2026/blob/main/docs/testing/tc-coverage.md"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Created by the Product Owner on 1 November 2026 from the canonical Release 1 entry, which recorded Jira creation as an outstanding follow-up.
